nodes.text: Pot's warm, love. What do you need?

choices.text: Where do I cook out in the world?

nodes.text: Anything you catch, a fire makes better: bird, beef, the brook's fish once you've the patience for a rod. Any village fire serves a traveller, and out in the wild you'll build your own. Same knack everywhere.
South of the bridge, near bank: berries, fibre for Ottery's twine, and sageroot any healer will thank you for. Take a full pocket. The bank never minds.
Go on then, once. {item:cooked_chicken} Careful, it's hot. After this you cook your own, love. I'm not being hard on you. I want you able to manage.
Warm hands, dry boots. Off you go.
